description: Tool to list DisplayVideo360AdvertiserLinkProposals on a property. Use when you need to retrieve Display & Video 360 advertiser link proposals associated with a Google Analytics property. Results support pagination for large datasets.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing DisplayVideo360AdvertiserLinkProposals on a Google Analytics property.

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of resources to return. If unspecified, at most 50 resources will be returned. The maximum value is 200; higher values will be coerced to the maximum.
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous ListDisplayVideo360AdvertiserLinkProposals call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page. When paginating, all other parameters must match the call that provided the page token.
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. The name of the property to list DisplayVideo360AdvertiserLinkProposals under. Format: properties/{property_id} (e.g., properties/489591273).
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: AnalyticsAdminPropertiesDisplayVideo360AdvertiserLinkProposalsListRequest

name: list_dv360_link_proposals

nextPageToken.description: Token for retrieving the subsequent page. Omitted if no further pages exist.
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token

adsPersonalizationEnabled.description: Immutable. Enables personalized advertising features. Defaults to true if unset.
adsPersonalizationEnabled.title: Ads Personalization Enabled

advertiserDisplayName.description: Output only. Display name of the Display & Video 360 advertiser (populated for proposals originating from DV360).
advertiserDisplayName.title: Advertiser Display Name

campaignDataSharingEnabled.description: Immutable. Enables campaign data import from Display & Video 360. Defaults to true if unset.
campaignDataSharingEnabled.title: Campaign Data Sharing Enabled

costDataSharingEnabled.description: Immutable. Enables cost data import (requires campaignDataSharingEnabled). Defaults to true if unset.
costDataSharingEnabled.title: Cost Data Sharing Enabled

linkProposalStatusDetails.description: Output only. Status information for the link proposal.
linkProposalStatusDetails.title: Link Proposal Status Details

validationEmail.description: Input only. Email address of target advertiser admin for verification purposes.
validationEmail.title: Validation Email

LinkProposalStatusDetails.description: Schema for link proposal status details.

linkProposalInitiatingProduct.description: Indicates whether the link proposal originated from Google Analytics or the linked product (Display & Video 360).
linkProposalInitiatingProduct.title: Link Proposal Initiating Product

linkProposalState.description: Current state of the link proposal (e.g., AWAITING_REVIEW_FROM_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS, AWAITING_REVIEW_FROM_DISPLAY_AND_VIDEO_360, WITHDRAWN, DECLINED, EXPIRED, OBSOLETE).
linkProposalState.title: Link Proposal State

requestorEmail.description: Email address of the user who initiated the link proposal.
requestorEmail.title: Requestor Email

LinkProposalStatusDetails.title: LinkProposalStatusDetails
